text: Hollis Pike's yard. Hulls bought, sold, mended and improved.
Mind the timber, it's seasoning. Like me.
Every ship in the Reach has a bit of my sawdust in it somewhere.
A wanted captain needs a fast ship. I don't ask questions. I just charge more.
Listen to that thunder. Nobody sane is at sea tonight.
Storm's right on top of us. Stay in the dry a while.
Every timber in the harbour's groaning. Ugly night.
Wretched rain. Gets into everything.
Rain again. Good for the cisterns, bad for the soul.
You're dripping on my floor, by the way.
Late to be wandering about.
Night's when the cursed come walking. Keep a lantern lit.
Can't sleep either, eh?
Up with the gulls, I see.
Early start, {player}.
Mist'll burn off by mid-morning.

options.label: Tell me about going below deck.

text: Sloop to start. Schooner if you trade, she's the fastest thing afloat. Brig or frigate if you fight. Galleon if you carry.
Bring your old deed and coin and I'll trade you up. Never throw a ship away.
Sneak up to me holding the deed, with her hold empty, and I'll buy her back for half her value. Hulls, not cargo.
Hull plating, gun carriages, fine canvas, cargo bulkheads, and swivel guns for the rail.
Flags too: run up the Skull and Cutlasses, or the Tidewatch Ensign if you're feeling respectable.
Press H aboard and you'll be in her belly: quarters, galley, the hold, a gun deck on the big ones. Furnish it how you like.
